the age-dependent changes in the anti-infective immunity of the genital tract of women.
the age-dependent differences in local anti-infectious immunity of the female reproductive tract.
the age-dependent differences in immunoglobulins and neutrophils of the cervical and vaginal secret in women of the reproductive period and the post-menopausal period.

the reproductive tract of young girls and women of reproductive age is characterized by high resistance to infections, while in women of menopausal age this resistance is significantly reduced.

the immune system in the reproductive tract of young women is less active than in women in the premenopausal and postmenopausal periods.
